description: This file defines the AccessManagerInterface interface for access control in Drupal, including methods for checking route access, request access, and route match access.

classes.name: AccessManagerInterface
classes.description: Interface for attaching and running access check services in Drupal.

methods.name: checkNamedRoute
methods.description: Checks access for a named route with parameters against access check services.

methods.name: checkRequest
methods.description: Executes access checks against an incoming request.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks a route match against applicable access check services.
